prompt: On a rocky cliffside on Mount Olympus, a muscular Hercules is wrestling with a Hydra. A winged Pegasus is standing on a ledge behind Hercules; the Pegasus has pristine white feathers, contrasting with the dark, scaly skin of the Hydra. The number of the Hydra's heads is one more than the number of legs on Pegasus. Zeus is floating on a cloud above them, holding one lightning bolt, which casts a brighter light than the ambient daylight. The number of Hydra's necks Hercules is holding is twice the number of lightning bolts Zeus is holding. Zeus is pointing the lightning bolt at the Hydra. Hercules is looking at the Hydra's main head. The Hydra is trying to bite Hercules with its other heads. The cliff is under Hercules and the Hydra. Zeus appears older, with a longer beard, than Hercules. The Pegasus is pawing at the rock. Hercules is between the Hydra and the Pegasus.
